customManagers.description: The Testcontainers image is a string literal, so no built-in manager sees it. Without this it silently drifts from the Postgres in docker-compose.

packageRules.description: Group all minor and patch npm updates together. Matched by datasource so the Biome `$schema` lands in the same PR as @biomejs/biome.
Postgres runs in both compose files and in the Testcontainers suite; a split bump means tests pass against a version production is not running.
The React type definitions live in DefinitelyTyped, so `group:monorepos` does not pull them in with react and react-dom. Split majors type-check against the wrong React.
